d: Benjamin Netanyahu is facing a fight to hold on to power after his bloc fell short of a majority in Israel's election. His biggest challenger, Gadi Eisenkot, has been given the first chance to form the next government. But with deep divisions among the parties backing him, Netanyahu could still have a path back to power. What are his options? Can he bring his political rivals together? And what happens if no one manages to form a government? Palki Sharma explains, why Netanyahu's political future remains uncertain.
